title: setup hook --scope user --yes creates ~/.claude/settings.json with the guard, from any folder, and leaves the project alone
source: intended: docs/decisions.md v0.2 row (setup hook --scope user, plan 2.4): the guard registered in ~/.claude/settings.json for the owner's own session, same rules as project scope
intent: INTENDED behavior (plan 2.4, owner question 8). `--scope user` needs no project: from the home folder it writes the same canonical file as the project scope to `~/.claude/settings.json`, printing the path as `~/.claude/settings.json`, with no `commit` note (the file is not in a repository). Nothing is written in the project.
